description: Remove tracked keywords from an app. Frees the slots against the plan limit; position history is kept, so re-adding a term later does not start from nothing.

app_id.description: Apptail app id for one of YOUR apps — get it from get_account. Not the numeric id in an App Store URL (that is apple_app_id).

keyword_ids.description: Apptail keyword ids to stop tracking, as returned by get_keywords. Ids, not terms — two apps can track the same word and only these rows are removed. Frees the slots against your plan limit. Position history is kept, so re-adding a term later does not start from nothing.

name: remove_keywords

app_id.description: The app these terms were tracked for.

remaining.description: How many keywords this app still tracks, across every storefront.

removed_count.description: How many keywords were actually untracked. Lower than `requested_count` when some IDs were not tracked for this app.

requested_count.description: How many keyword IDs were passed in.

title: Remove Keywords
